text:
sam: Heads-up — planning to roll runtime engine 2.8.0-quant (nightly -> release candidate) during the midnight PST change window (00:30–01:30). Staging preflight green except one perf regression on dedicated pools. link: https://ci.redwood/run/2323
deploy-bot: preflight: staging: ✅, canary: ✅, dedicated-sim: ⚠️ perf-regression (p90 +22%)
miriam: @sam can you paste the failing flamegraph snapshot? we need to see which kernel regressed
sam: flame snippet: `conv_forward_fp16 -> matmul_kernel_v2` spike at 1.1s vs 0.8s baseline. Also saw increased cache misses on prefix cache.
kevin: that matmul_kernel_v2 diff was introduced by the new microkernel selector (PR #4987) to favor packed GEMM on Ampere for long seqs. Might be suboptimal for our dedicated GPU driver version.
anand: we should avoid full rollout to dedicated pools until we confirm fallback to matmul_kernel_v1. Proposal: pin dedicated to 2.7.3 and canary/hosted get 2.8.0 with kernel selector override to v1 for dedicated.
sre-oncall: operationally OK if we keep dedicated pinned. Need runbook steps for rollback and traffic swap. also decide SLA impact window. :warning:
ci-bot: artifact 2.8.0-quant built: sha256:aa3f4c...; package: engine-2.8.0-quant.tar.gz
miriam: quick test: can we force kernel selector via ENV: `ENGINE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_v1` at runtime? if yes, we can ship 2.8.0 to dedicated with that env until driver update lands.
sam: confirmed, env toggle exists. But it reduces perf on Ampere hosting by ~5% (ok for dedicated).
kevin: risk: if someone later removes the env override in deploy manifests, dedicated could get worse perf. Suggest commit-level pin + runtime env as double-safety: pin config in dedicated pools to image:engine:2.7.3 and set fallback for canary route to 2.8.0+env.
anand: rollout plan I propose (short):
  1) Hold dedicated: set reserved capacity to engine:2.7.3 (pin) immediately 
  2) Push 2.8.0 to hosted canary 10% for 30m with kernel selector default
  3) If canary stable, promote hosted to 100%
  4) For dedicated: test image 2.8.0 with `ENGINE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_v1` in a small subset of dev-dedicated pools (5%) for 1 hour
  5) If green, either keep pin until driver patch or gradually switch dedicated to 2.8.0+legacy selector and then remove pin after drivers are validated

miriam: add to that: update release notes + runbook snippet for ops: commands to swap traffic and rollback
sam: runbook excerpt:
```
# pin dedicated
redwoodctl pool update --pool dedicated-prod --image engine:2.7.3
# deploy canary hosted
redwoodctl deploy --route hosted-api --image engine:2.8.0 --canary 10% --wait 30m
# quick rollback (hosted)
redwoodctl deploy --route hosted-api --image engine:2.7.3 --force
# force kernel selector on a node
kubectl set env daemonset/engine-node ENGINE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_v1 -n redwood-runtime
```
kevin: one more thing: add a deploybot guard that rejects changing engine image on dedicated pools without `--allow-driver-mismatch` flag. avoids accidental unpinning.
sre-oncall: agreed. add an alert: if p90 latency on dedicated > +15% for 10m, auto-rollback to pinned image.
sam: approvals: @miriam and @kevin please ack and add to release notes. we'll schedule the dedicated pin now and canary deploy at 00:30 PST.
miriam: ack. I'll update release-notes/engine/2.8.0.md and add the caveat and workaround.
kevin: ack. I'll open a short PR to deploybot to enforce the image-change guard and add integration test for the env toggle.
anand: I'll coordinate a follow-up tomorrow to verify driver upgrade timeline and whether we can remove the pin.
ci-bot: deployment job queued for pinning dedicated pools (job 4482)
deploy-bot: job 4482: success — dedicated-prod pinned to engine:2.7.3 by pipeline `ops/pin-dedicated`
sam: thanks. I'll start the hosted canary at 00:30 PST and post updates here. :rocket:
(00:52) sam: hosted canary 10% running, telemetry looks OK so far (p50/p90 within expected ranges)
(01:20) sam: canary window complete — no errors, perf within thresholds. promoting hosted to 100% now
(01:27) deploy-bot: hosted-api promoted to engine:2.8.0 (100%)
(01:42) miriam: quick check on dedicated-dev subset where we applied legacy selector: perf matches pinned baseline. looks good.
(01:50) sam: final: dedicated remains pinned to 2.7.3. we'll keep the env toggle available as a bridge. filing a follow-up to remove pin once driver update is validated. ticket: https://redwood/issue/INF-1229
(01:50) sam: closing thread for this rollout. thanks all :clap:
